title: my_dad_deleted_three_years
display_title: My Dad Formatted My Hard Drive to 'Teach Me a Lesson' — He Had No Idea What Was On It
beats: My dad (61M) formatted my external hard drive to 'teach me a lesson about screen time' — three years of parkour runs, gone in nine minutes.
That drive held every clean run I'd ever recorded since I was 17, including the one twelve-minute course I built map by map and never uploaded anywhere else.
I came home, saw the drive wiped and reformatted, and just started shaking — he said 'it's just a game, stop being dramatic, you're 20 years old.'

Except three months earlier I'd quietly used clips from that exact footage to apply for a game-design scholarship, and the acceptance letter — the one requiring the original files as proof of authorship — showed up two days later.
I handed him the rejection email I had to send back, told him exactly what he erased, and watched him go pale and stop talking for a week. Was I wrong to let him sit in it?
